messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On what date was the last regular thorough check of the cell's nanoScan3 laser scanner carried out?

response.text: In quale data è stato effettuato l'ultimo controllo approfondito periodico dello scanner laser nanoScan3 della cella?
